_comment: Centrally governed KPI glossary (SRS 8.1). Every dashboard measure references one of these definitions.

kpis.definition: Occupied sellable room nights / Available sellable room nights
kpis.exclusions: Out-of-order rooms are excluded from available rooms. No-shows and cancellations are not sold rooms.
Net of discounts, excluding taxes and service charge. Converted to USD at the arrival-date rate.

kpis.definition: Room revenue / Available sellable room nights
Total operating revenue less operating expenses under the approved accounting definition
kpis.exclusions: General ledger basis. Excludes depreciation, interest, tax and management fees.

kpis.definition: Net sales / Covers or guests served
kpis.exclusions: Net of discounts, excluding taxes and service charge.

kpis.definition: Cost of food and beverage sold / Net food and beverage sales
kpis.exclusions: Recipe cost at time of sale.

kpis.definition: Covers served / (Seats x planned turns per day)
kpis.exclusions: Planned turns are set per outlet in the outlet master.

kpis.definition: Cost of goods sold / Average inventory
Store-SKU days with zero stock on hand / Total store-SKU days

kpis.exclusions: Hourly ride capacity during operating hours.

kpis.definition: Daily visitors / Licensed daily park capacity
Booked service hours / Available service hours
kpis.formula: sum(completed duration) / (therapists x 10 operating hours x days)

kpis.definition: Incremental attributable return relative to campaign investment
kpis.exclusions: Attributed revenue is the incremental share reported by the marketing platform.
Month-to-date budget is pro-rated by elapsed days.

kpis.definition: % promoters (9-10) minus % detractors (0-6) from post-stay surveys
